title: Novel or Not? PatEx-Gym: Agentic Prior-Art Search for Novelty Assessment in Patent Examination
abstract: arXiv:2610.33503v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Patent examination is a challenging real-world task that requires agents to discover sparse prior art, iteratively refine queries, inspect technical evidence, and produce novelty assessments documented in Office Actions (OAs) across heterogeneous scientific and technical domains. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on static and limited candidate sets, leaving the full search--reasoning--assessment process underexplored. We present PatEx-Gym, the first framework for developing and evaluating agents for patent examination, which integrates three components. translated_title: 新颖与否？PatEx-Gym：面向专利审查中新颖性评估的智能体化现有技术检索
translated_abstract: 专利审查是一项具有挑战性的现实世界任务，它要求智能体发现稀疏的现有技术、迭代式地优化检索查询、审查技术证据，并在异构的科学技术领域中生成记录于审查意见通知书中的新颖性评估。然而，现有的基准测试大多关注静态且有限的候选集合，使得完整的“检索—推理—评估”流程未得到充分探索。我们提出了PatEx-Gym，这是首个用于开发和评估专利审查智能体的框架，它集成了三个组成部分。首先，PatEx-Bench提供了1000个真实的审查任务、两个包含超过100万件专利和5.2万篇科学论文的大规模检索语料库，以及一个支持迭代检索、文档访问、推理和审查意见通知书生成的运行时环境。其次，我们引入了PASS，这是一个无需人工标注的现有技术智能体检索轨迹合成框架。具体而言，该框架利用文档……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个用于开发和评估专利审查智能体的框架PatEx-Gym，其包含1000个真实审查任务、超百万件专利与5.2万篇论文的大规模检索语料库，并创新性地引入无需标注的检索轨迹合成框架PASS，从而完整覆盖现有技术“检索—推理—评估”的全流程。
en_tdlr: This paper presents PatEx-Gym, the first framework for developing and evaluating patent examination agents, featuring PatEx-Bench with 1K realistic tasks and large-scale corpora of over 1M patents and 52K papers, along with PASS, an annotation-free search trajectory synthesis framework that enables the full search–reasoning–assessment pipeline.
